summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 34 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: I went looking for the AI weed vape that gives you Bitcoin for smoking
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Charter Communications data breach affects 4.9 million accounts
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 7 articles published in the last 24 hours
